| 项目 | 当前 ROS 模型的约定 |

| 单位 | **rad**；串口节点不会自动把度转成弧度 |

207c1654684d94f11ab0834d73f7fed906fb2e71.translatedText:
| Items | Conventions of the current ROS model |
|---|---|
| Unit | **rad**; the serial port node does not automatically convert degrees to radians |
| Positive yaw direction | Viewed from above the vehicle,**counterclockwise is positive** |
| yaw zero position | the gimbal forward direction is aligned with the chassis forward direction |
| Positive pitch direction | **pitching downward is positive, tilting upward is negative** |
| pitch zero position | the pitch mechanism is aligned with the yaw layer coordinate axes; this does not represent horizontal relative to the world on a slope |
